title: Controlled cross-model activation transplant -- the five-arm control harness
description: clozn.analysis.transplant's output: at ONE candidate-model site (a residual `l_out` layer or an `ffn_out` layer), write the reference model's captured internal state into the candidate and observe whether the candidate's answer moves toward the reference's -- alongside the four controls (candidate_self_transplant, random_equal_norm, shuffled_layer, no_write_replay) that make a 'yes' interpretable rather than an overclaim. This is a PRIMITIVE, not a search: it reports what happened at ONE named site under all five arms plus a structural verdict on whether the reference arm's movement is reference-specific. It never claims a site is a cause of anything model-wide -- that vocabulary belongs to a later slice that actually searches across sites. A metric that could not be honestly computed is OMITTED from the relevant `metrics` object and named in the sibling `omitted` list with a reason -- never a zero or a guess standing in for a measurement.

model_ref.description: Identifying facts about one side of the pair, mirroring clozn.pair-compatibility.v1's own model_ref (this document embeds that contract's model_a/model_b verbatim as reference_model/candidate_model).

metric_omission.description: One metric that could not be honestly computed, and why. Never paired with a same-named key in the sibling `metrics` object.

tensor_ref.description: A content-addressed reference into clozn.analysis.tensor_store -- the raw float32 vector actually written for this arm, at this position, for a later slice (or a human) to re-inspect or re-apply exactly.

site.description: hook='residual' writes/captures the l_out-<layer> residual-stream row (OVERWRITE semantics -- see hook_vocabulary's stream_semantics_summary); hook='ffn' writes/captures the ffn_out-<layer> MLP-contribution row (CONTRIBUTES/additive semantics). Both are full n_embd-width, position-major, and share the SAME mechanical hidden_size gate (see clozn.analysis.transplant's module docstring for why pair_compatibility's residual_transplant verdict is reused for the ffn hook too). Per-head kqv_out sites are out of scope for this schema version -- head_write's value width (d_head) is only known from a runtime probe, not statically, unlike the two hooks here.

write_spec.description: The write actually issued to the candidate engine for this arm: layer/positions match the engine wire contract exactly (values.size() == positions.size() * n_embd, position-major); `vectors` is present only when store_tensors=True.

arm_metrics.description: target_token_logprob/rank read the CANDIDATE's own /score output at readout_position for target_token_id (typically the reference model's own top-1 answer there -- the thing a transplant is being tested for RECOVERING, per the prior transplant-localization study's own method, docs/research/DISTRIBUTED_FUNCTION.md). top1_is_target is the discrete 'did the candidate's own top-1 answer become target_token_id' signal this harness's reference_specific rule is built on.

arm.description: `write` is OMITTED entirely (never null) for the no_write_replay arm -- it issues no write at all.

pair_compatibility.description: The full clozn.pair-compatibility.v1 document that gated this transplant, embedded verbatim -- a stored result is self-describing about what compatibility was actually confirmed before it was produced.

shuffled_layer.description: The DIFFERENT, dimensionally-compatible layer the shuffled_layer control arm writes the SAME reference vector to -- never equal to site.layer.

readout_position.description: The continuation position whose top-1/target-token metrics are read to judge whether an arm 'moved the output toward the reference'.

random_seed.description: The seed the random_equal_norm control's direction was drawn from -- recorded so that arm is exactly reproducible, not just described.

baseline.description: The candidate's own no-write score, read at readout_position -- what every arm's movement is measured relative to.

arms.description: Exactly the five control arms, in execution order: reference_transplant, candidate_self_transplant, random_equal_norm, shuffled_layer, no_write_replay.

analysis.description: The structural verdict this schema exists to make unskippable. instrument_sane is False (never assumed True) whenever candidate_self_transplant could not be confirmed to reproduce baseline, or any write-bearing arm's write_applied was not confirmed true -- and when instrument_sane is False, reference_specific is OMITTED rather than computed, because every write-bearing arm is uninterpretable at that point. reference_specific (when present) is True only if the reference arm's top-1 flipped to target_token_id AND the random_equal_norm control's did not -- the exact rule this project's prior transplant-localization study needed a control to enforce after its first pass overclaimed (docs/research/DISTRIBUTED_FUNCTION.md).
